errors.card_declined_split: . Return the cash to the customer; nothing from the sale was recorded.
errors.query_failed: Could not check the payment status
errors.device_ref_required: Enter the terminal reference number from its receipt. A card sale is not accepted on your confirmation alone.
errors.split_invalid: Enter a cash amount above zero and below the total.

stock_not_deducted: Stock was not deducted automatically: no warehouse is linked to the shift's branch

open.sub: Open a shift to start selling
open.branch_label: Shift branch (sets the warehouse stock is deducted from)

closed.title: Closed shift summary
closed.pending_body: . The shift was closed with them open; they move to the settlement matching list until the provider's answer or evidence resolves them:

search_placeholder: Search by name or scan the barcode, then Enter...

cart.title: Cart
cart.empty: Tap an item to add it

device_ref.intro_offline: The connection is down and the payment gateway is linked: charge on the terminal directly, then enter
device_ref.intro_standalone: No payment gateway is linked: charge on the card terminal, then enter
device_ref.ref_bold: the reference number printed on its receipt
device_ref.outro: . The sale is recorded as unverified until the card settlement matches it.
device_ref.label: Terminal reference number

evidence.title: Resolve a pending payment with evidence
evidence.intro: {{amount}} · The provider is asked first; if it answers, its answer resolves the payment. A resolution by evidence is not final until the card settlement matches it.

verifications.title: Unverified card payments: settlement period {{n}} days
verifications.unresolved_title: Unresolved card payments from closed shifts ({{n}})
verifications.status_unknown: Pending: waiting for the provider's answer or evidence

offline_receipt.title: Sale recorded offline ✓
offline_receipt.notice: Temporary receipt: the compliant invoice is issued automatically, dated this sale, as soon as the connection returns
offline_receipt.no_qr: Receipt without the ZATCA code: the legal name and VAT number were not cached before the outage. Complete them in the company profile when the connection returns.

receipt.title: Sale completed ✓
receipt.clearance_fallback: Full tax invoice: it must be cleared by ZATCA before it is handed over; print it from the invoices screen after clearance.
receipt.no_qr: Receipt without the ZATCA code: complete the legal name and VAT number in the company profile.
receipt.stamp_error: Not stamped at the time of sale: the receipt was issued with the five tags; stamping and reporting retry automatically. Reason: {{reason}}
receipt.negative_stock: Warning: resulting stock is negative: {{items}}. Check the stock count
